annotations.title: Is this grocery product cheaper elsewhere? (Schnäppchen Jäger)

description: For one product id from a Schnäppchen Jäger search, returns its price, the identical article in the other Swiss shops (matched by barcode) and the cheapest similar product per shop for the same amount, each with the date it was read and a link. Similar products are not the same article. By zzd (schnaeppchenjaeger.zzd.ch). Not counted against the search allowance.

lang.description: Language of names and links. Default de.

productId.description: The product id from a grocery search result.
